title: begonia paucilobata var. maguanensis
intro: Begonia paucilobata var. maguanensis, commonly known as the Maguan Begonia, is a plant species belonging to the Begoniaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the treatment of fever, cough, and inflammation, as well as its ability to act as a diuretic. The health benefits of Maguan Begonia include its potential to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues, while its therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
